Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Add furniture anchoring (pick a nearby placed item when saving a preset, and the offset corrects against its live position/rotation instead of a fixed world point) and couple pairing: pair with a partner over /tell from the Animations tab, then any preset you click while paired queues and highlights for both of you, playing together automatically once you've both picked something.
